title: AI Video Annotator
description:
About the Role
We are looking for detail-oriented annotators to help label robot manipulation videos for AI training purposes. You'll watch short videos of robots performing manipulation tasks (filmed from three synchronized camera angles) and produce precise, structured, natural-language descriptions of the actions taking place. This work directly supports the development of robotics AI models and requires strong written English, sharp observational skills, and the discipline to follow a detailed style guide consistently.
Project Details

•
Job Title: Project Cursa - Robot Manipulation Video Annotator

•
Location: Remote in India/Philippines﻿/Egypt/Mexico

•
Work type: Freelance

•
Language: English

•
Pay Rate: US$3.5 per hour

What You'll Do

• Watch short robot manipulation videos, each filmed from three synchronized camera views (an overhead view and views from each of the robot's two wrist-mounted cameras).

• Break each video into time segments and write clear, natural-language descriptions for each segment.

• Apply labels at three levels of detail for each applicable segment:

•
Atomic motion (a few seconds) - a single small movement (e.g., "close fingers around the red handle")

•
Skill / subtask (several seconds to ~20 seconds) - a complete, meaningful action (e.g., "pick up the red block by its edge")

•
Task / goal (up to ~1 minute) - the overall purpose of a sequence of skills (e.g., "place all blocks in the container")

• Ensure every moment of video is covered by a label at two or more of these levels - no gaps, including idle or pause moments.

• Accurately describe exactly what happens, including when something doesn't go as planned (a dropped object, a failed grasp, a slipped grip). Precision matters more than making the robot look successful.

• Cross-reference all three camera angles: use the overhead view to understand the overall scene and object identity, and the close-up wrist views to confirm exact contact and grasp details.

• Follow a detailed style guide covering vocabulary for actions, spatial relationships, object descriptions, and manner of movement, applying it consistently across many episodes.

• Participate in periodic calibration sessions to align your labeling with the team and the client's reference examples.
What We're Looking For
Required:

• Strong written English - you'll write dozens of short, precise descriptive sentences per video and need to vary your language rather than repeating the same phrases.

• Sharp attention to detail - able to distinguish small differences (a successful grasp vs. a fumble, a push vs. a drag, which specific object part is being touched).

• Comfort following a detailed, structured style guide and applying it consistently, even in ambiguous or edge-case scenarios.

• Basic comfort with spatial/mechanical description (left/right, above/below, naming object parts like handles, lids, or edges).

• Reliable, self-directed work habits - this is often heads-down work with periodic check-ins rather than close supervision.
Nice to Have:

• Prior experience with video annotation, data labeling, transcription, or QA work.

• Familiarity with robotics terminology (grippers, end-effectors, manipulation) - helpful but not necessary, as the style guide is self-contained.

• Experience with annotation tools such as Label Studio.

description:
ABOUT ENODE

The grid was built for predictable, centralised power. Today it's absorbing intermittent supply from grid scale solar and wind, alongside dynamic demand from EVs, heat pumps, and home batteries. The missing piece is software that can connect and orchestrate these devices at scale.

We’re the layer between the home and the grid. Our platform https://enode.com/platform/overview connects every asset, coordinates every home and shapes thousands as one. Asset connectivity https://enode.com/platform/assets gives energy retailers one API for 1,000+ device models across 100+ brands. Home energy coordination https://enode.com/platform/homes turns that connection into smarter behavior at home, like charging an EV in the cheapest hours or using more of your own solar. Residential flexibility https://enode.com/platform/flexibility brings connected homes together into a dispatchable resource the grid can count on.

Europe’s largest energy companies build on Enode https://enode.com/company: retailers, utilities and the teams that trade for them. The platform spans 1.7M+ connected households and 5,000+ MW of controllable load. We’re backed by Y Combinator, Lowercarbon Capital and Creandum.

The decisions made now will shape how the next grid gets built. We’re looking for people who take ownership, think clearly under complexity and care deeply about the craft of building software that matters.

AI IS FUNDAMENTAL TO HOW WE WORK

AI is how a team our size keeps rewiring the way we work, fast enough to match what our mission demands. We look for people who reach for AI as a reflex and who can drop a habit that used to work. People who care about unblocking others, not just about what they ship themselves. If that's not quite how you work yet but it's the direction you're heading, we'd still like to hear from you. We assess this in our interview process, alongside everything else we look at.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We're hiring a Senior Marketing Manager to build Enode's growth engine and shape how energy companies across Europe discover and understand what we do.

Millions of EVs, heat pumps, batteries and solar systems are coming onto the grid, and energy companies need software to connect and coordinate them. We have a strong product, a new brand and a growing list of enterprise customers. We now want to build a marketing function that sharpens how we tell our story and creates a steady flow of demand from the companies we most want to work with.

This is an opportunity to build marketing at a renewable energy tech company in one of the most interesting parts of the energy transition, where your work has a direct effect on how quickly homes electrify.

You'll report to Fredrik, our VP Revenue, and work closely with our account executives, Customer Success and Partnerships teams. You'll also work with Daniël, our Head of Design, and the Design team, who own our brand and visual identity.

In this role, you will:

- Build Enode's demand generation engine, creating a steady flow of conversations with the energy companies we most want to work with.
